info.title: Baqaya API
info.description: Production API for Baqaya — offline-first ledger, customers, payments, sync, statements, and reminders.

servers.description: Baqaya API Server (same host as this documentation)

post.description: Sends a one-time password to the given phone number. Rate limited to 5 requests per 5 minutes per phone.
Verifies OTP, registers/updates device, returns Sanctum `access_token` and rotating `refresh_token`. Copy `access_token` into Authorize.
Rotates refresh token and returns a new access token pair.
Creates an immutable payment record. Use correction endpoint to change amount.
Reversal + corrected payment. Required for edit-payment screens.

message.example: Assalam o Alaikum, aap ka baqaya 1500 PKR hai.

get.description: Returns the shop owned by the authenticated user. No shop UUID header is required.

post.description: Creates the authenticated user's shop. Each user may own exactly one shop.

422.description: Validation error or shop already exists

patch.description: Updates the shop owned by the authenticated user.

post.description: PDF is generated asynchronously via queue. Poll download endpoint when status is completed.
Processes a batch of offline operations with `request_id` and per-operation `operation_id` idempotency. Duplicate request_id returns cached response; duplicate operation_id is skipped.

get.description: Returns entities with server_version greater than `since_version` and updates device sync cursor.

post.description: Creates an immutable credit transaction. Amount cannot be changed later — use correction endpoint.
Financially safe edit: keeps original record, creates reversal + corrected entry. Required for edit-transaction screens.
Creates a reversal entry and marks the original as reversed. Does not delete history.
Manual adjustment entry (in/out) without correcting an existing transaction.

patch.description: Updates notes, reference, description, category, attachment only. Does NOT change amount, customer, or balance.

AuthTokenResponse.description: Returned by OTP verify and token refresh. Copy `access_token` into Swagger Authorize.

bearerAuth.description: Paste the access_token from OTP verify (Bearer prefix optional)
